column2: [intro]
In my life, there are all these constraints
But I find escape in my little machines
Connected to my phone, I'm in my zone
These notifications give me chills, I'm not alone
Dopamine, dopamine, I feel it vibrate
When I hear my phone ring, it’s my fate
Dopamine, dopamine, it makes me soar
These little gadgets, I’ll never ignore
On the subway, I don't lift my head
My virtual world is more fun, more dead
Swipe right, swipe left, it keeps me amused
Who needs real connections when I'm so used?
Dopamine, dopamine, I feel it vibrate
When I hear my phone ring, it’s my fate
Dopamine, dopamine, it makes me soar
These little gadgets, I’ll never ignore
[ solo ]
Dopamine, dopamine, I need the rush
But I don't want to lose in this sad hush
Dopamine, dopamine, I take a step back
To live my real life, more vibrant, on track
[outro]
